verdict.rationale: Authy's documentation offers no export of TOTP secrets in an open format. Its backup feature is an encrypted, Authy-only sync, and the 'migration' doc covers moving API integrations to Twilio Verify, not exporting user secrets. Community reports consistently say there is no export option; the only routes are unofficial hacks using a deprecated Chrome extension or a debug-mode Electron app, which are user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, I can export all my TOTP secrets in an open, readable format and leave for another app whenever I choose — no lock-in
